comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
cowherder.approach: Careful! Man wid him cow dem block di road!
Herder inna di road, boss — ease off!
Big man and him cow a hold up traffic — swerve, nuh!
cowherder.hit: Yuh lick di man cow! Him nah go forget dat!
Bwoy, yuh run down di cow! Di herder vex bad!
Jesus! Yuh knock di cow? Dat a go cost yuh!
cowherder.clear: Herder move him cow dem — road clear, carry on!
Di cow dem gone now. Big up di herder!
